summary: DIYhomie iteration v2 (structured guide flow) fully tested. Backend: 29/30 pytest passed, 1 skipped (out-of-credits drain via real LLM is too costly for CI; logic reviewed in code). All NEW endpoints verified end-to-end: POST /api/projects/{id}/guide returns full structured guide {overview, tools, materials, safety_warnings, code_alert, common_mistakes, troubleshooting, inspection_checklist} + steps[] (each {id,index,title,instruction,visual_description,done}) and deducts exactly 3 credits, idempotent on second call (no double-charge). POST /steps/{id}/done toggles done, returns {done_steps,total_steps,progress}, auto-marks project completed when all steps done. POST /ask returns conversational answer and deducts 1 (text) / 2 (voice) credits. PATCH /projects/{id} updates favorite/notes/status/touch. GET /projects summary now includes progress/done_steps/total_steps/favorite/status/has_guide. Profile PUT now accepts pain_point as a LIST (multi-select) and persists. Auth register/login/me, supplies (Amazon affiliate + bundle), community post/reply/author-only-verify with +10 credits +2 voice reward, mock billing tier grants and invalid tier 400 — all pass. Step image generation via gpt-image-1 still returns ~30KB+ base64 (~10-15s). Frontend (390x844 mobile viewport): Onboarding → 5-card Survey (experience single-select, tools categorized MULTI grid, budget single, frustrations MULTI, expectations single) → Register → Paywall → Tabs all navigate correctly. Home launcher shows the new 'BUILD MY PLAN' UI, populated popular projects, and credit meter '60 cr'. Workspace route /project/{id}?new=1 is wired and backend /guide call was observed succeeding (200 OK in logs). Projects tab renders filter chips (All/In Progress/Favorites/Completed) with empty state CTA. Brain: fallback OpenAI gpt-4o-mini (PERPLEXITY_API_KEY empty — expected). No critical bugs. Minor: 'drill' icon name is not valid in material-community (cosmetic console warning); DM Sans font assets still fail to decode on web (existing issue); shadow* and pointerEvents deprecation warnings persist (existing).

minor.issue: passlib bcrypt version warning in logs (`AttributeError: module 'bcrypt' has no attribute '__about__'`). Auth still works — cosmetic only.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py at 753 lines — approaching the 700-line guideline. Split into routers (auth, projects, guide, community, billing) for v3.
build_guide endpoint correctly returns the full project doc (with `guide` and `steps`) and is properly idempotent (re-checks project.guide before charging) — server.py:431.
set_step_done uses `steps.id` array-match in MongoDB update — atomic and correct.
GET /projects strips heavy fields (steps, guide) for list performance — good.
_owned() helper uses naive substring match (tools 'drill' matches 'Cordless Drill' OK, but 'saw' would match 'Jigsaw'). Acceptable for v2; consider exact-token match later.
Old single-step endpoint /projects/{id}/step still exists but is unused by new UI (acknowledged by main agent).
Project ownership enforced via user_id filter in every query — multi-tenant isolation good.
402 Out-of-credits paths exist on /guide (server.py:434) and /ask (server.py:516) with proper detail string.
